title: Research Brief: Impact of generative AI on journalism
summary: News organisations are deploying Azure OpenAI copilots alongside Azure AI Search over archives to accelerate scripting while investing in provenance signals to sustain trust.
key_insights: Copilot-assisted workflows cut script drafting time by 40% while keeping editors in the loop.
Content safety guardrails and watermarking experiments boost reader trust scores in pilot markets.
Unions advocate for reskilling budgets, emphasising investigative and data journalism capabilities.
